messages:
Sam K: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Sam K: What I did: merged routing-policy PR to prefer regional model variants for /v1/generate and bumped default rate limit for unauthenticated clients. Deployed to staging.

Sam K: Blocker: saw a 4x spike in 429s in eu-west 1 at 09:12 UTC after the deploy. Can't repro locally. Logs show a bunch of short bursts from a single client ID.

Sam K: Today: need help validating token-bucket config and confirm if the canary rollout for auth-cache ran concurrently. @Priya N @Carlos R any pointers?

Priya N: looking now. quick metric dump — env:staging, timeframe: 09:00-09:30 UTC
Priya N: 99p latency is fine, but rate-limited requests count jumped from ~6/min to ~140/min for client `acme-prod`.
Priya N: my guess: policy mismatch where `route_match` for /v1/generate didn't include the `x-client-tier` header so default rate bucket applied. moving to open a tiny config PR.

Carlos R: FYI I rolled out a change to auth-token caching yesterday (shortened ttl to 30s) to reduce mem pressure. Could cause more auth calls and thus higher per-client token usage -> more 429s.
Carlos R: Reverting now in canary to see if rate-limits drop. /cc @Marta L for canary coord.

Marta L: I'll attach to canary and run the traffic replay script `scripts/replay-client.sh --clients acme-prod --rate 200/s` from infra. Will report results in ~15m. :hourglass: 

deploy-bot: deploy started by Carlos R · canary=auth-cache-revert · commit=fa3b2d4

Priya N: opened config PR: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/289 — small change in envoy matchers. PTAL @Sam K

Sam K: thanks Priya. If revert reduces 429s we can keep auth-ttl at 30s and update routing match as permanent fix. If not, revert stay and we investigate token-bucket sizing.

Marta L: replay done. with auth-cache revert: 429s dropped to baseline. baseline was ~5/min now ~7/min (noise). reverting looks like it fixed spike.

Carlos R: confirmed canary is healthy, rolling to rest of fleet. Will follow up with a postmortem note and add a test for `x-client-tier` header in routing unit tests.

Sam K: great. action items:
- Carlos: full rollback/rollforward (done)
- Priya: PR to update envoy matchers + add unit test (in flight)
- Marta: add replay case to canary checklist
- Sam: update runbook with common auth-rate signatures

Sam K: thanks all, ping me if you need pairing. wrapping up the async standup. :thumbsup:
